2 Zoom & filter

Taxonomy matrix

rows: main scope › task · columns: techniques and other design dimensions · bars: who publishes it, by venue community

Click a row or column label to include it, shift-click to exclude it, click a cell to filter by both. Click a dimension name to switch between ∪ any (union) and ∩ all (intersection) of its included labels. Bars: current result, stacked by venue community, against the whole corpus (gray). Legends are filters too.
